local function createBottomButton(text, xPos, alignment)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 1, 0)
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
	btn.Text = text
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
	btn.TextSize = 13
	btn.Parent = ButtonBar
	if alignment == "Left" then
		btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, xPos, 0, 0)
		btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	else
		btn.Position = UDim2.new(1, xPos, 0, 0)
		btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	end
	return btn
end

-- ========== SYSTEM TABÓW ==========
local tabs = {}
local currentTab = nil
local showingOutput = false
local MAX_TABS = 10
local PINK = Color3.fromRGB(235, 64, 120)

local function getNextTabNumber()
	local used = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(tabs) do used[t.number] = true end
	for i = 1, MAX_TABS do
		if not used[i] then return i end
	end
	return nil
end

local function updateLineNumbers(textBox)
	local lines = 1
	for _ in textBox.Text:gmatch("\n") do lines = lines + 1 end
	local str = ""
	for i = 1, math.max(lines, 1) do str = str .. i .. "\n" end
	LineNumbers.Text = str
end

local function showExecutorView()
	showingOutput = false
	OutputContainer.Visible = false
	SubTabBar.Visible = true
	OutputTab.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	ExecutorTab.TextColor3 = PINK
	if currentTab then
		for _, t in ipairs(tabs) do
			t.textBox.Visible = false
			t.frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
			t.label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
		end
		currentTab.textBox.Visible = true
		currentTab.frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
		currentTab.label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
		updateLineNumbers(currentTab.textBox)
	end
end

local function showOutputView()
	showingOutput = true
	OutputContainer.Visible = true
	SubTabBar.Visible = false
	OutputTab.TextColor3 = PINK
	ExecutorTab.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	LineNumbers.Text = ""
	for _, t in ipairs(tabs) do t.textBox.Visible = false end
end

local function switchToTab(tab)
	showExecutorView()
	for _, t in ipairs(tabs) do
		t.textBox.Visible = false
		t.frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
		t.label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
	end
	tab.textBox.Visible = true
	tab.frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
	tab.label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
	currentTab = tab
	updateLineNumbers(tab.textBox)
end

local function closeTab(tab)
	if #tabs <= 1 then return end
	local idx
	for i, t in ipairs(tabs) do if t == tab then idx = i break end end
	if not idx then return end
	tab.frame:Destroy()
	tab.textBox:Destroy()
	table.remove(tabs, idx)
	if currentTab == tab then switchToTab(tabs[math.min(idx, #tabs)]) end
end

local function createTab()
	if #tabs >= MAX_TABS then return end
	local num = getNextTabNumber()
	if not num then return end
	local tab = { number = num }

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Parent = TabsContainer
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 65, 0, 18)
	tab.frame = frame

	local label = Instance.new("TextButton")
	label.Parent = frame
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 0)
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
	label.Text = "Tab " .. num
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
	label.TextSize = 12
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	tab.label = label

	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeBtn.Parent = frame
	closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 0)
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, 0)
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
	closeBtn.Text = "x"
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
	closeBtn.TextSize = 11
	closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() closeTab(tab) end)

	local textBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
	textBox.Parent = EditorContainer
	textBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	textBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 5)
	textBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -35, 1, -10)
	textBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	textBox.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	textBox.MultiLine = true
	textBox.Text = ""
	textBox.TextColor3 = PINK
	textBox.TextSize = 14
	textBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	textBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	textBox.Visible = false
	tab.textBox = textBox

	textBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		if currentTab == tab then updateLineNumbers(textBox) end
	end)

	label.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() switchToTab(tab) end)
	table.insert(tabs, tab)
	switchToTab(tab)
	return tab
end

local function runCode(code)
	if not code or code == "" or code:match("^%s*$") then return end
	local chunk, err = loadstring(code)
	if chunk then
		local ok, msg = pcall(chunk)
		if not ok then warn("Błąd wykonania: " .. tostring(msg)) end
	else
		warn("Błąd składni: " .. tostring(err))
	end
end

-- ========== OUTPUT ==========
local function addLog(text, color)
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Parent = OutputContainer
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 16)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	label.TextSize = 13
	label.TextColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	task.defer(function()
		OutputContainer.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, OutputLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 8)
		OutputContainer.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, OutputContainer.CanvasSize.Y.Offset)
	end)
end

LogService.MessageOut:Connect(function(message, messageType)
	local color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	if messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageWarning then color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50)
	elseif messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageError then color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
	elseif messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageInfo then color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 180, 255) end
	addLog(message, color)
end)

addLog("-- Output --", PINK)
addLog("Waiting for console logs...", Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120))

-- ========== KLIKI ==========
OutputTab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(showOutputView)
ExecutorTab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(showExecutorView)
AddTabBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(createTab)

ExecuteBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if showingOutput or not currentTab then return end
	runCode(currentTab.textBox.Text)
end)

ClearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if showingOutput then
		for _, c in ipairs(OutputContainer:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("TextLabel") then c:Destroy() end
		end
		addLog("-- Output cleared --", Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120))
	elseif currentTab then
		currentTab.textBox.Text = ""
	end
end)

-- Script Hub
ScriptHubBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AZYsGithub/chillz-workshop/main/ScriptSearcher"))()
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[Script Hub]: " .. tostring(err))
	else
		print("[Script Hub]: Loaded")
	end
end)

-- Settings
SettingsBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	SettingsCard.Visible = not SettingsCard.Visible
end)

SettingsClose.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	SettingsCard.Visible = false
end)

AutoToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	autoExecute = not autoExecute
	if autoExecute then
		AutoToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 180, 60)
		print("[Settings]: Auto Execute ON")
		if currentTab and not showingOutput then
			runCode(currentTab.textBox.Text)
		end
	else
		AutoToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 40, 40)
		print("[Settings]: Auto Execute OFF")
	end
end)

CloseButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)

MinButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	MainFrame.Visible = not MainFrame.Visible
end)

-- Start
createTab()
